title: Earnings Statement Glossary: Early Opt-In Credit on a Locked Guarantee
content:
**Early opt-in credit.** A locked guarantee recorded on a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings guarantee opt-in includes an early opt-in credit, which follows how many calendar days the opt-in comes before the window's start date, counted from the opt-in date to the window's start date: 3 or more days earn the flat 15.00; at least one but fewer than 3 days earn 4.00 for each of those days; an opt-in on the window's start date earns nothing. The window is that of the earnings guarantee offer opted into, as its start date stands on the offer.

The credit is a USD amount added to the guaranteed amount stated on the offer after that stated amount has been multiplied by whatever scales apply to it; the credit is never scaled, and the sum is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

| Calendar days from the opt-in date to the window's start date | Early opt-in credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 (opt-in on the start date) | 0.00 |
| 1 | 4.00 |
| 2 | 8.00 (4.00 for each of 2 days) |
| 3 | 15.00 (flat) |
| 4 or more | 15.00 (flat) |

**Dated illustration (hypothetical offer whose window starts on 20 June).**

| Opt-in date | Days before the start date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 14 June | 6 | 15.00 |
| 17 June | 3 | 15.00 |
| 18 June | 2 | 8.00 |
| 19 June | 1 | 4.00 |
| 20 June, before the window starts | 0 | 0.00 |

The count is of calendar dates only: an opt-in late in the evening of 19 June and one early that morning are both 1 day before a 20 June start date.
